# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialog < Base
    def initialize(open: false, **attrs)
      @open = open
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    # `contents` keeps the Stimulus wrapper out of layout, like shadcn's
    # element-less Root.
    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          controller: "ruby-ui--alert-dialog",
          ruby_ui__alert_dialog_open_value: @open.to_s
        },
        class: "contents"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogAction < Base
    def view_template(&)
      render RubyUI::Button.new(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        variant: :primary
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogCancel < Base
    def view_template(&)
      render RubyUI::Button.new(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        variant: :outline,
        data: {
          action: "click->ruby-ui--alert-dialog#dismiss"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogContent < Base
    SIZES = %i[default sm].freeze

    def initialize(size: :default, **attrs)
      raise ArgumentError, "size must be one of #{SIZES.join(", ")}" unless SIZES.include?(size.to_sym)

      @size = size.to_sym
      super(**attrs)
    end

    # Title and Description take their ids from the context; the children are
    # captured first so the <dialog> only references the ones that rendered.
    def view_template(&block)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_alert_dialog]
      id = attrs[:id] || "ruby-ui-alert-dialog-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      names = context[:ruby_ui_alert_dialog] = {id: id}
      body = block ? capture(&block) : ""
      dialog(**dialog_attrs(id, names)) { raw(safe(body)) }
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_alert_dialog] = previous
    end

    private

    def dialog_attrs(id, names)
      aria = {}
      aria[:labelledby] = names[:labelledby] if names[:labelledby] && !author_aria?(:label, :labelledby)
      aria[:describedby] = names[:describedby] if names[:describedby] && !author_aria?(:describedby)
      (aria.empty? ? attrs : mix({aria: aria}, attrs)).merge(id: id)
    end

    def author_aria?(*keys)
      keys.any? { |key| attrs[:"aria_#{key}"] || attrs.dig(:aria, key) }
    end

    # No backdrop click action: an alert dialog only closes through its
    # buttons or Esc (APG alertdialog).
    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "alertdialog",
        data: {
          ruby_ui__alert_dialog_target: "dialog",
          size: @size
        },
        class: [
          "group/alert-dialog-content fixed open:grid top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-50 w-full gap-6 rounded-xl bg-popover p-6 text-popover-foreground outline-none ring-1 ring-foreground/10 data-[size=default]:max-w-xs data-[size=sm]:max-w-xs data-[size=default]:sm:max-w-lg",
          "backdrop:bg-black/10 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop:backdrop-blur-xs",
          "duration-100 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=closed]:fill-mode-forwards motion-reduce:animate-none!",
          "backdrop:duration-100 data-[state=open]:backdrop:animate-in data-[state=open]:backdrop:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:backdrop:animate-out data-[state=closed]:backdrop:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:backdrop:fill-mode-forwards motion-reduce:backdrop:animate-none!"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogDescription < Base
    # Inside AlertDialogContent the description describes the dialog (aria-describedby).
    def view_template(&)
      names = context[:ruby_ui_alert_dialog]
      # Only the first one gets the generated id, so ids stay unique.
      return p(**attrs, &) if names.nil? || (!attrs[:id] && names[:describedby])

      id = attrs[:id] || "#{names[:id]}-description"
      names[:describedby] ||= id
      p(**attrs.merge(id: id), &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "text-sm text-balance text-muted-foreground md:text-pretty *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3 *:[a]:hover:text-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogFooter < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 group-data-[size=sm]/alert-dialog-content:grid group-data-[size=sm]/alert-dialog-content:grid-cols-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogHeader < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "grid grid-rows-[auto_1fr] place-items-center gap-1.5 text-center has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]:grid-rows-[auto_auto_1fr] has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]:gap-x-6 sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:place-items-start sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:text-left sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]:grid-rows-[auto_1fr]"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogMedia < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    # data-slot drives the header's media layout (has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]).
    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "alert-dialog-media"},
        class: "bg-muted mb-2 inline-flex size-16 items-center justify-center rounded-md sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:row-span-2 *:[svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-8"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogTitle < Base
    # Inside AlertDialogContent the title names the dialog (aria-labelledby).
    def view_template(&)
      names = context[:ruby_ui_alert_dialog]
      # Only the first one gets the generated id, so ids stay unique.
      return h2(**attrs, &) if names.nil? || (!attrs[:id] && names[:labelledby])

      id = attrs[:id] || "#{names[:id]}-title"
      names[:labelledby] ||= id
      h2(**attrs.merge(id: id), &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "font-heading text-lg font-medium sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:group-has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]/alert-dialog-content:col-start-2"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class AlertDialogTrigger < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          ruby_ui__alert_dialog_target: "trigger",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--alert-dialog#open"
        },
        class: "inline-block"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Alert Dialog

A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
AlertDialog do
  AlertDialogTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Show dialog" }
  end
  AlertDialogContent do
    AlertDialogHeader do
      AlertDialogTitle { "Are you absolutely sure?" }
      AlertDialogDescription { "This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove your data from our servers." }
    end
    AlertDialogFooter do
      AlertDialogCancel { "Cancel" }
      AlertDialogAction { "Continue" } # Will probably be a link to a controller action (e.g. delete account)
    end
  end
end
```

### Small

```ruby
AlertDialog do
  AlertDialogTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Show dialog" }
  end
  AlertDialogContent(size: :sm) do
    AlertDialogHeader do
      AlertDialogTitle { "Allow accessory to connect?" }
      AlertDialogDescription { "Do you want to allow the USB accessory to connect to this device?" }
    end
    AlertDialogFooter do
      AlertDialogCancel { "Don't allow" }
      AlertDialogAction { "Allow" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Media

```ruby
AlertDialog do
  AlertDialogTrigger do
    Button(variant: :destructive) { "Delete chat" }
  end
  AlertDialogContent do
    AlertDialogHeader do
      AlertDialogMedia(class: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive") do
        svg(xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", viewbox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", stroke_width: "2", stroke_linecap: "round", stroke_linejoin: "round") do |s|
          s.path(d: "M3 6h18")
          s.path(d: "M19 6v14c0 1-1 2-2 2H7c-1 0-2-1-2-2V6")
          s.path(d: "M8 6V4c0-1 1-2 2-2h4c1 0 2 1 2 2v2")
        end
      end
      AlertDialogTitle { "Delete chat?" }
      AlertDialogDescription { "This will permanently delete this chat conversation." }
    end
    AlertDialogFooter do
      AlertDialogCancel { "Cancel" }
      AlertDialogAction(variant: :destructive) { "Delete" }
    end
  end
end
```

## Inside a form

The dialog renders in place, and HTML does not allow nested forms: a button_to inside AlertDialogAction loses its own form and submits the outer one instead. Render the AlertDialog after the form, or give the action button a form attribute that points to a form elsewhere on the page.
